apps.name: Ghost Hub
apps.description: Every Ghost app in one place. Install and update them anywhere, from GitHub or your PC.
changes: Update all installs your apps in one go. The first time it updates an app Android asks once, then updates are silent.
Update all shows how much it will download, and the notification lists each app's new version.
App info and Uninstall buttons in each app's details. Update checks keep working after a restart.

apps.name: Ghost GPS
apps.description: Set your location anywhere: teleport, walk a route or steer with the joystick.
changes: New compact look: one slim search pill at the top and a small glass dock at the bottom, so the map gets almost the whole screen.
Fold the dock down to just its tabs with the ⌄ button, and a pulsing Live dot shows when your location is being changed.
There & back: long-press Loop to walk a route out and home again, on repeat.
Long-press the app icon to teleport straight to a favourite; long-press Live to copy your fake coordinates.

apps.name: Ghost Volume
apps.description: Your own volume for every app, switched automatically when you open it.
changes: Headphone volume limit: cap media volume whenever headphones or Bluetooth are connected, to look after your ears.
Sound / Vibrate / Silent buttons for your ringer, right above the system volumes.
Quick Settings tile to pause or resume per-app volume, and long-press an app to remove it.

apps.name: Ghost Terminal
apps.description: A shell on your phone, with a side list of commands that work on your device.
changes: Colour output: 'ls --color' and friends now show real colours instead of odd symbols.
Slow commands say how long they took, failures show in red, and a cyan light sweeps under the bar while a command runs.
Find in output (menu), and tap the prompt to jump to ~, /sdcard, Downloads or /.
Pin favourite commands, make aliases (alias ll='ls -la'), 'history', '!!' and '!7', and it remembers your folder.

apps.name: Ghost Weather
apps.description: Live weather where you are and anywhere you save: hourly, 7-day, rain alerts at a glance.
changes: New Air quality tile (with PM2.5) and a Daylight tile that says if tomorrow is longer or shorter.
Optional morning rain alert at 7:30 when rain is likely today.
Rain chance bars for the next 24 hours, and "warmer/colder than yesterday" under the temperature.
A Tomorrow pill on the front, and the widget shows today's rain chance.

apps.name: Ghost School
apps.description: Homework, timetable, grades, targets, exams and revision, with XP, levels and badges.
changes: Home-screen widget: what's on now or next, and how much homework is due.
Two-week timetables (Week A / Week B), homework notes, and your own reminder time with exam heads-ups.
Grades tell you what you need next time to hit your target, and Quick-fire has Fractions and Negative numbers.
The focus timer shows a live countdown in your notifications.

apps.name: Ghost Image Editor
apps.description: Crop, rotate, filters, adjust, draw and add text to your photos. Nothing leaves your phone.
changes: New Frame tool: add a border, or make a photo square with a colour or blurred background.
Straighten slider, plus Blur, Pixelate and Marker brushes to hide private details.
✨ Auto in Adjust, and long-press Save to pick the size (full, 1080, 720) or PNG.

apps.name: Ghost VPN
apps.description: One-tap VPN through free volunteer servers in many countries. Tests servers from your phone to find the fastest.
changes: Reconnects to the same country if the tunnel drops on its own (switch off in the menu).
Recent sessions in the menu: where you connected, for how long and how much data; tap one to go there again.
Long-press the big button to connect to the fastest country, and Measure speed runs a real download test.
Tap your IP address to copy it.

apps.name: Ghost Browser
apps.description: A private browser: ad & tracker blocker, incognito tabs, and sites forget you when you leave.
changes: 📖 Reader view: just the words of an article in a clean, easy-to-read sheet, with a reading time.
Bookmarks: save pages with ☆ in the menu and open them from the start page. Kept only on your phone.
Print or save any page as a PDF, and a text size setting for every page.
Downloads is now one tap away in the menu.

apps.name: Ghost Video
apps.description: Video editor: trim, filters, colour, speed, rotate, captions and sound. Saved on your phone.
changes: Crop to a shape (Square, Story, Portrait, Wide) with a live crop box.
Join clips: add more videos to play after this one when you export.
Sound: new Quiet and Fade in/out options.
Film-strip trim slider and a 🔁 loop preview.
